title: Decentralized Feature Models
description:
An interactive site for learning decentralized feature models, the approach from the paper Towards Decentralized Feature Models. Each scope owns its own feature model, and models coordinate only through named capabilities (requires/provides) instead of a shared global model.
Explore worked examples (a phone, a microservice webshop, an open-source distro), configure scopes independently, and watch a decentralized resolver notify only the scope that can fix a missing capability. A sandbox lets you build your own models, including cross-scope global rules.

title: HAnS
description:
HAnS (Helping Annotate Software) is an open-source (Apache 2.0) IntelliJ plugin that simplifies feature annotation.
HAnS provides autocompletion, quick fixes, a feature model view, and a metrics view (lines of feature code, scattering degree, tangling degree, and annotated files). HAnS is programming language-agnostic.

title: FM-PRO
description: FM-PRO (Feature Modeling Process) is a feature modeling process to systematically create feature models, covering strategies used by companies, when creating platforms from scratch or re-engineering them from existing variants. Feature models obtained from this process can be used for configuration, planning, evolution, reasoning about variants, or keeping an overview of understanding of complex software platforms.
